errors.what: Foot path is a small, nearly elliptical loop (about 37 mm wide by 41 mm tall) with no flat-bottomed stretch. The characteristic Jansen path is a wide D shape with a long flat ground phase and a lifted return. The panel foot x/y values vary smoothly, with no flat section, so the link lengths or the assembly configuration look wrong.
The foot appears to circulate clockwise (bottom, then left, then top, then right) for a counter-clockwise crank. Direction or phase may be inverted.
